description: For a CAC business name: which annual returns are due from its registration date, which are overdue, about what filing them with FastCAC costs (per year and in all), and when the next one is due. Needs the registration date (it's on the certificate). Without it, the annual returns checker on fastcac.com looks the date up by BN number.
name: check_annual_returns

estimated_total.description: Naira, with FastCAC, if none were filed.

price_per_year.description: Naira, FastCAC's price per year filed (about).

title: Work out annual returns due
